phase_name: Rebase planner, general-research, and general-implementation in core

objectives.description: Extract real @-reference sets and enumerate hooked entries for all three agents
objectives.note: planner-agent: 5 refs, 16 hooked entries. general-research-agent: 8 refs, 14 hooked entries. general-implementation-agent: 11 refs (excl. index.json self-ref), 34 hooked entries (report approximated 33; re-derivation found 34, per the phase's own Scope Hypothesis instruction to re-enumerate rather than assume).

objectives.description: Drop agents[] hooks for unreferenced entries; set on_demand:true where hooks empty; keep genuinely referenced entries
objectives.note: planner-agent: kept plan-format.md+return-metadata-file.md+workflows/task-breakdown.md (10,400 tok); dropped 13 unreferenced entries (4 became on_demand). general-implementation-agent: kept its 9 genuinely-referenced entries including the already-hooked 5-file core bundle plus checkpoint-before-overflow.md, context-exhaustion-detection.md, subagent-continuation-loop.md, standards/git-staging-scope.md (16,688 tok); dropped 25 unreferenced entries (7 became on_demand) including the explicit high-confidence candidates from the plan (patterns/task-lock.md, the four skill-lifecycle entries, standards/postflight-tool-restrictions.md) plus standards/status-markers.md's agents[] hook (its commands[] hook -- /task, /plan, /implement -- was preserved intact, confirmed post-edit). general-research-agent: kept return-metadata-file.md+report-format.md+context-exhaustion-detection.md (7,160 tok, exactly matching the plan/report's stated floor); dropped 11 entries including the one deliberate exception to the generic 'referenced => keep' rule -- patterns/checkpoint-before-overflow.md was dropped from general-research-agent DESPITE being genuinely @-referenced, following the plan/report's explicit Finding 4 determination that this is a rare/conditional 'Stage 3.6 git-checkpoint step' path, numerically necessary to reach the 7,160 floor (margin 840 under the 8,000 cap) -- keeping it would measure 8,568, still over cap.

objectives.description: Evaluate standards/status-markers.md dual hook, drop agents[] keep commands[]
objectives.note: Confirmed post-edit: agents:[] (dropped from both planner-agent and general-implementation-agent), commands:[/task,/plan,/implement] preserved intact.

objectives.description: Add hooks for genuine unconditional references currently missing
objectives.note: None needed: planner-agent's two unconditional refs (return-metadata-file.md, plan-format.md) were already hooked; general-research-agent's (return-metadata-file.md) already hooked; general-implementation-agent's 5-file core bundle was already fully hooked.
